requirement_text: Load session snapshot from disk

requirement_text: Auto-download gcp-assured-workloads plugin from GitHub release

Parse asset URL for current OS/arch (darwin-x86_64 darwin-arm64 linux-x86_64). Download tarball verify SHA256 extract to ~/.aegis/plugins/. chmod +x. Show progress.
